title: Build a MapLibre geojson source spec from a feature service
prompt: Write a standalone TypeScript ESM program that turns the Esri GeoServices feature layer at <HONUA_EVAL_BASE_URL>/rest/services/EvalIncidents/FeatureServer/0 into a MapLibre geojson source specification, without a browser. Use loadHonuaFeatureServiceGeoJson from @honua/sdk-js/map with a HonuaClient constructed with { baseUrl: <base URL> } and options { outFields: ["OBJECTID", "name"] }. The returned spec is { type: "geojson", data: <GeoJSON FeatureCollection> } and is what map.addSource would receive. Print exactly one line to stdout: {"type": <spec.type>, "featureCount": <number of features in spec.data>}.

context.notes: Golden workflow: mount-on-MapLibre exercised at the source-spec seam so it stays Node-safe and deterministic (mock lane).
